scope: All original BMP captures under the spaces-path curated, workspace and results evidence directories; visual layout, control visibility and readability only.
reviewMethod: All 27 exact final-candidate captures individually viewed at original pixel resolution through lossless PNG conversions. Parent reviewer inspected curated/results; delegated independent reviewer inspected workspace. Original BMP bytes were unchanged and independently matched to report hashes and dimensions.
summary: No blocking overlap, unreadable fixed label, missing fixed action or visible redraw defect was observed in the supplied captures. Scrollable panes and graph viewports intentionally clip offscreen content.
limits: Evidence is limited to the supplied spaces-path captures at reported 96 DPI. No ordinary-path, high-DPI, multiple-monitor or representative-PC acceptance is inferred from this receipt; the ordinary path has its own separate receipt.

Workspace scenario filenames minimum and 1280 are labels, not measured window sizes: the 15 main workspace images are 1024x728, manager is 830x700 and two option crops are 452x489. This subset does not establish a 960-pixel outer-window view.

Curated captures are five 940x680 auxiliary windows and one 1024x728 main workspace. The three Results/DAG/icon captures are 1044x788, so rendered-control inspection does not establish their desktop work-area containment.

Scroll-pane text, long path edit values, list-column labels and graph card titles can be clipped or ellipsized within their controls; offscreen content and full scrolling ranges were not inferred from still images.

Still images do not independently establish keyboard focus, successful actions, physical input behavior, temporal scrolling, absence of flicker, or scientific correctness. Those claims belong to separately recorded functional evidence.
This review covers these three visual subsets only and is not an overall CI, release or deployment acceptance decision.
